sources.entry: Gemini Omni AI - Craft cinematic AI videos with Gemini Omni, the unified omni-model — generate, edit, and remix clips in native 4K with built-in audio and Director's Mode. #freemium

summary.name: Gemini Omni
summary.one_liner: Gemini Omni is a web-based AI video generator built on a unified omni-model that turns text, images, and video references into clips with built-in audio and in-chat editing.
use_cases: Generating short cinematic clips from text prompts
Animating sketches or product photos into video
Making ad creative and text animation reels
Editing or extending existing video clips
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Gemini Omni as a unified model that takes text, image, video and audio inputs and produces video output. Its generator offers text-to-video and image-to-video modes, aspect ratio choices, 720P/1080P/4K resolution, quality tiers (Lite, Fast, Flash), and an 8-second default length with audio always on. The 1.1 update adds scene extension up to 40s, first and last frame control, and a cheaper 360p draft. In-chat editing lets users remix clips, swap objects and rewrite scenes via natural language, plus reframe and send-to-phone options. Subscription tiers list monthly credits and access to other models such as Veo 3.1 and GPT Image 2.
notable: Unified omni-model handling text, image, video and audio inputs in one system
Native audio generation (Foley, ambience, dialogue) in a single pass
In-chat editing: remix, object swap, scene rewrite via natural language
Scene extension up to 40s and first/last frame control in version 1.1
caveats: Free use requires login; paid plans range from $15 to $50 per month on the page, with credit-based generation
Watermark removal and commercial license are listed only on paid tiers
The page's FAQ says a single render is up to 10 seconds, which conflicts with the 40s scene-extension claim elsewhere on the page
Marketing-heavy page; performance and quality claims are not independently verified
